topic: Cognition Agent Memory Repo and Google EmbeddingGemma 2

steering_ledger.text:
Run research-intake routine on the following sources:

https://cognition.com/agent-memory-repo
https://huggingface.co/google/embeddinggemma-2

I'm curious about whether anything useful can be distilled out of the first to enhance our project knowledge mgmt, and out of the second as an upgrade to the embedders we use in our orchestration stack

actionable_ledger.action: [UNVERIFIED] Compare task-focused cold-start knowledge briefs and links to reusable diagnostic artifacts with current project-wiki queries, ContextBundle preparation and episodic recall; retain only a demonstrated consumer gap.
[UNVERIFIED] Assess per-owner/project memory composition and cross-agent question/finding discoverability against the existing session bus and per-writer records.

[UNVERIFIED] Evaluate whether a source-change-driven, proposal-only maintenance pass can preserve supersession and exceptions better than current review; do not install a periodic job or alter approved compilation cadence.

[UNVERIFIED] First verify text-only runtime, revision, pooling and prompt semantics against a separate configured REPL context.search candidate; compare held-out native code/document retrieval against the incumbent without changing its serving or index.
[UNVERIFIED] Consider a separate MiniLM text-description retrieval comparison and, independently, a multimodal retrieval branch; preserve the existing CLIP store and its vector identity.

[UNVERIFIED] Treat episodic/routing substitution as a later schema/retraining decision: its default 1024d BGE stores are not compatible with 768d/256d candidate vectors. Re-embedding and isolated identity are required.

[UNVERIFIED] A later deciding screen must freeze corpus/query inputs and baseline, retain per-item raw outputs and all failure/abstention counts, use held-out/later queries, and declare quality/latency stop or promotion criteria before compute.

[UNVERIFIED] Read the exact skill and format with the Cognition source to distinguish implemented local behavior from the broader proposed maintenance and sharing loop; feature-mine before any adoption decision.

[UNVERIFIED] Verify pinned library/model APIs and query/document/pooling identity before designing one isolated workload comparison; compare current dependency locks rather than globally upgrading the environment.

[UNVERIFIED] Verify upstream architecture and conversion/pooling/prefix support against the frozen production source and a fresh experimental candidate; keep a full-precision reference, do not patch/build the frozen tree.

[UNVERIFIED] If an approved deciding probe later runs, pin checkpoint/converter/runtime and retain finite-vector, shape, normalization and native retrieval/latency outputs for each variant in an isolated index.

dedup.scope: All surviving index entries, normalized URL and arxiv identifiers; both inputs and three expansion URLs have no collision.

bounded_search.contradictions: Publisher-only model comparison, explicit dtype/prompt/truncation caveats; memory local trial narrower than proposed autonomous loop. No independent version-2-vs-EPYC controlled result surfaced; bounded absence provisional. Older version-1 issues not version-2 evidence.

state.verification_scope: Stage 1 only; publisher discovery and read-only current-consumer comparison. No source claim dive-verified, runtime trial or production change.
